description: Phase 5: Address semantic review findings - OData injection, CI thresholds, StaffGuard redirect, unbounded dict growth, sitemap URL format
steps: 1. Fix OData injection in _delete_stale_chunks (search_indexer.py): Validate slug matches ^[a-z0-9-]+$ before using in filter. If it doesn't match, skip deletion and log a warning.
2. Fix CI deploy threshold in deploy-all.yml: Change from 0 back to 5. Update echo message to match.
3. Fix CI coverage threshold in ci-backend.yml: Change from 60% to 45%. Update comments and messages.
4. Fix StaffGuard redirect: Change !user case back to /login, keep role check case as / since user IS logged in.
5. Fix unbounded _email_send_times dict growth in resend_client.py: Add pruning when len > 10000.
6. Fix sitemap URL format in content_publisher.py: Revert to https://syrabit.ai/{ch.slug} without /notes suffix.
acceptance_criteria: search_indexer validates slug before OData filter interpolation
StaffGuard redirects unauthenticated users to /login and unauthorized (wrong role) to /
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/apps/backend && python -m ruff check app/services/content/search_indexer.py app/services/comms/resend_client.py app/services/content_publisher.py
findings: All 6 review issues fixed. Ruff passes clean on all modified Python files. Changes are minimal and targeted.
